title: Embedding into matching sample indices
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $P$ be a finite subset of $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, and let $z$ assign a sign to each index in $P$. Given natural numbers $M,R$ and samples $(x_i,s_i)\in\{\pm1\}^n\times\{\pm1\}$ for $i<R$, suppose at least $M$ sample points agree with $z$ on every index in $P$. Then there is an embedding of $\{0,\ldots,M-1\}$ into $\{0,\ldots,R-1\}$ whose image consists of indices of such matching samples.
